steps.caption: Open Review. The badge counts what's waiting.
At the top: quick counts — files needing input, unverified contact details, outreach drafts and failed jobs.
New sections above the tabs: transaction approvals waiting for you…
…lease dates needing review and lease terms to confirm — decisions from Transactions and Leases also wait here.
Imports to review: spreadsheet rows waiting for your check.
Unverified contact details: emails and phones nobody has checked yet. Open the person to verify.
Captures to review: notes and files from Capture. Open one, check it, press Reviewed.
Tabs split the rest. Record changes first.
Each card: the record, 'Material' tag, now vs proposed, and the evidence quote.
'why do we believe this?' opens the source behind the proposal.
Buttons: Approve & apply, Approve only (apply later), Ask to clarify, Reject; or Edit proposed values.
The lease proposal from the PDF (area 18,000 → 18,500). Something to check first? Request more info.
Say what's missing and press Ask — it moves to 'Needs more info' and adds a linked task.
The notes change (budget ₹90, move-in June 2027) looks right: Approve & apply.
Applied — it leaves the queue and appears in History & undo.
Identity merges: duplicate companies, people or buildings — never merged silently.
External drafts: outreach drafts waiting to be checked and sent by you.
Documents: generated documents still in draft.
Conflicts: two sources disagree on a value — you choose.
Stale records: data too old to trust until rechecked.
